identity: Raincall Basin lives by the rains, and Vek's bandits have started selling them back as a tithe.

quests.title: A Garden Is No Wallow
quests.text: Welcome to Raincall, where we catch the rain and the Mudsnouts sit on what it grows. Kill eight tapirs by day in the {name:rainwood}, which grows {zone_area:rainwood}, so our gardens can stand up again. Strangers have started demanding a rain tithe from the farms, too. I have tended this basin for years, and the clouds have never once sent a collector.

quests.title: Mind Where the Path Hisses
quests.text: A wet root trips you; a Lancehead takes offence at your whole foot. Kill eight vipers after dark on the paths through the {name:rainwood}. Their venom is quick, so mind where you step and keep something to drink close at hand.

quests.title: The Rain Owes You Nothing
quests.text: Those rain-tithe men are Rain Grifters, prowling the {name:rainwood} after dark among the vipers. Kill six of them. They claim to collect for Vek, but Vek has yet to send us so much as a drizzle.

quests.title: Let the Scouts Hear It
quests.text: Those collectors have to carry our coin somewhere, and I cannot follow them while keeping this village above water. Go to Raincall Outpost and tell Neshi Reedstep what you found on the paths. She can follow a trail through rain that would wash the spots off a cat.

quests.title: A Trail with Claws
quests.text: I can follow a tithe collector through the {name:cloudwood}, {zone_area:cloudwood}; doing it with Servals following me is another matter. Kill eight of those cats there by day and give my scouts room to work. The collectors leave clumsy tracks, but I would prefer to read them without teeth in my shoulder.

quests.title: Someone Ate the Trail
quests.text: We marked the trail with rope, and the Stilt Gnawers took that as an invitation to supper. Kill eight after dark in the {name:cloudwood}. I can teach a scout to find a trail in the rain; I cannot teach one to find it inside a rat.

quests.title: Eyes on the Bowstrings
quests.text: Found them: Bandit Lookouts guard the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}. Kill eight, closing the distance or using cover when they keep you at bow range. A tree between you and an arrow is worth more than any brave speech.
quests.lesson: Archers keep their distance; close in or use cover.

quests.title: A Voice Behind the Bows
quests.text: There is someone in the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp} who did not volunteer: Veko Bluefeather. Veko refused the rain tithe, and the collectors found room for a prisoner. Go and speak with Veko while your work among the lookouts gives you an opening.

quests.title: Vek Can Keep the Bill
quests.text: Bandit Tithe-Keeper Vek is {dir_from_giver:tithe_keeper_vek}, counting coin in the middle of this camp as though he wrung every drop from the sky himself. Kill him and break his hold on the basin. I refused to pay before they locked me up, and I am certainly not paying a leaving fee.

quests.title: News Too Good to Whisper
quests.text: Take word of Vek's fall to Nalo Pathdrum at the shrine in Kezamba. The capital ought to hear that Raincall has no need of a man to sell it rain. I will spread the news here; I spent long enough tied up and quiet, and now I intend to be heard.

quests.title: Capes Before the Downpour
quests.text: A rain cape with a hole is just a very personal waterfall. Bring me three Leather from the Mudsnouts that roam the {name:rainwood} by day, {zone_area:rainwood}. If Daro already has you clearing the gardens, let one muddy walk earn its keep twice.

quests.title: Houses Should Not Bow
quests.text: Our stilt houses nod when the water rises, and I do not care for that sort of greeting. Bring me four Iron Bars and four Coal Lumps for the smith to make new brackets. I can mend the curtains, but someone else must persuade the walls to stay under them.
quests.lesson: Iron is the second tier of ore.

quests.title: Claws at the Loom
quests.text: Palm fibre knots itself tighter than gossip in a rainbound house. Bring me two Hooked Cat Claws from the Servals hunting by day in the {name:cloudwood}; my weavers need them to comb it out. The claws may come inside, but the rest of the cat stays where you found it.

quests.title: Our Tithe, Their Shirts
quests.text: I patch our capes while the tithe collectors strut about in fresh linen. Bring me three Linen Cloth from the Bandit Lookouts at the {name:bandit_camp} {dir_from_giver:bandit_camp}. Neshi wants their bows quiet; I want something for all the stitching their thieving has cost us.

quests.title: Bounty: Claws Above the Gardens
quests.text: Servals keep prowling the {name:highwood}, {zone_area:highwood}, by day, and our gardeners have enough to wrestle with. Kill six for this repeatable bounty. You can take it again twenty minutes after turning it in; I suspect the cats will keep their side of that arrangement.

quests.title: Bounty: Teeth on the Ropes
quests.text: Another rope chewed through, another scout walking in circles. Kill eight Stilt Gnawers after dark in the {name:highwood} for this repeatable bounty. It opens again twenty minutes after you turn it in; until the rats learn a different trade, I will keep paying.
